market_pulse.narrative: A wave of regulatory activity is shaping the iGaming landscape, from the EU's proposed online gambling tax to national compliance reviews in Sweden and Malta, and new guidance from the MGA ahead of the World Cup.

U.S. regulators and courts are increasingly targeting prediction‑market platforms, with the CFTC suing a state, DraftKings expanding into the space, and Nevada regulators moving against Kalshi, signalling a looming legal showdown.

Major operators are reshuffling leadership and pursuing high‑profile deals – Fortuna’s new ad campaign, ATG’s CEO appointment, Allwyn’s North America CEO hire, Bally’s Intralot’s bid for evoke, and Genlot’s partnership with Sizekhaya to modernise South Africa’s lottery.

New insights highlight the cost of poor affiliate tracking, the role of AI in building trust, and platform roll‑outs such as EveryMatrix powering BetAhoy, underscoring a push toward smarter tech and data‑driven operations.

The upcoming 2026 World Cup is driving regulatory focus (New York bill, Thai police crackdown) and market interest (World Cup betting site rankings), while operators prepare for heightened betting volume.
